summary: Churchill Capital Corp IX (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting termination of its merger agreement with Plus Automation (PlusAI), entered June 5, 2025, as amended. The agreement was mutually terminated effective April 20, 2026, due to market conditions. No termination fee or deal price was disclosed. Churchill cancelled its extraordinary general meeting and redemption deadline originally set for April 24, 2026. The SPAC now faces pressure to find a new target or liquidate. Watch for liquidation risk and potential extension vote.
